place.en: Black Pine Ridge · the broken stele

setup.zh: 蹄印一直走进岭口一块断碑后头。碑上只剩「勿入」两字；马家的狗，从来不过这块碑。爹说：你在这儿等我。
setup.en: The hoofprints run on past a broken stele at the ridge mouth. Only two characters are left on it: Do not enter. The Mas' dogs never go past this stone. Father says: wait for me here.

recap.zh: 断碑前，你和爹定了三条规矩，跨进了黑松岭。
recap.en: At the broken stele you and Father made three rules, and stepped into Black Pine Ridge.

zh: 岭口一块断碑，半截埋在土里。
碑后松林，一点风都没有。
en: A broken stele at the ridge mouth, half buried.
Two characters left: Do not enter.
Behind it the pines, not a breath of wind.

text.zh: 两个字刻得极深，几百年风吹雨打，笔画还是清清楚楚的，倒像刻字的人生怕后人看不清。
text.en: The two characters are cut very deep; after centuries of wind and rain the strokes are still perfectly clear, as if whoever carved them feared no one after would read them.

text.zh: 你捡了块石子扔进松林，石子落了地，竟没有一点声响。
text.en: You toss a pebble into the pines. It lands — and makes no sound at all.

label.en: The dead grass at its foot

text.zh: 碑脚下的枯草有半人高，一根根朝外倒着，倒像许多年前有人扒开过，又慢慢长拢了。
text.en: The dead grass at the stele's foot stands half a man high and leans outward, as if someone parted it long ago and it slowly grew back.

story.zh:
石坳村的孩子，还不会走路，便听过黑松岭的故事。岭口立着一块断碑，半截埋在土里。碑上的字早就认不全了，只剩最后两个字，还看得清清楚楚：**勿入。**

村里的老人说，进去十个人，回来一个。小满的爷爷，便是没回来的那九个之一。

父子两个站在断碑前面。碑后的松林黑沉沉的，没有风，也没有鸟叫，静得像有人把整座山的声音都装进口袋里拿走了。
story.en:
The children of Shi'ao Village heard the story of Black Pine Ridge before they could walk. At the mouth of the ridge stood a broken stone tablet, half buried in the earth. Most of the writing on it could no longer be made out. Only the last two words were still perfectly clear: **DO NOT ENTER.**

The old people of the village said that of ten who went in, one came back. Xiaoman's grandpa had been one of the nine who didn't come back.

Father and son stood in front of the broken stone. The pine forest behind it was black and heavy. There was no wind and no birdsong. It was so quiet it was as if someone had put the sound of the whole mountain into a sack and carried it off.

story_full.zh:
石坳村的孩子，还不会走路，便听过黑松岭的故事。岭口立着一块断碑，半截埋在土里。一块青黑的石头，几百年风吹雨打，四周的石头都长满了苔，它身上一点不生，干干净净，像天天有人擦。碑上的字早就认不全了，只剩最后两个字，还看得清清楚楚：**勿入。**

村里的老人说，进去十个人，回来一个，回来的那一个，也不肯说里面有什么。小满的爷爷，便是没回来的那九个之一。

说来也怪，马家把前山篦了一遍又一遍，二十条猎狗、几十个家丁，偏偏到了这块断碑跟前，一个也不肯往里多走一步。村里人说，马家的狗撵兔子撵到碑跟前，便夹着尾巴往回跑。

父子两个站在断碑前面。碑后的松林黑沉沉的，没有风，也没有鸟叫，静得像有人把整座山的声音都装进口袋里拿走了。
story_full.en:
The children of Shi'ao Village heard the story of Black Pine Ridge before they could walk. At the mouth of the ridge stood a broken stone tablet, half buried in the earth. It was a dark blue-black stone, and after hundreds of years of wind and rain, every other stone around it was thick with moss, yet not a scrap grew on it. It was clean, as if someone wiped it every day. Most of the writing on it could no longer be made out. Only the last two words were still perfectly clear: **DO NOT ENTER.**

The old people of the village said that of ten who went in, one came back, and the one who came back wouldn't say what was in there. Xiaoman's grandpa had been one of the nine who didn't come back.

The odd thing was, the Mas had combed the near hills over and over, twenty hounds and dozens of men, and yet when they reached this broken stone not one of them would take a single step further in. The villagers said that when the Ma dogs chased a rabbit as far as the stone, they turned tail and ran back.

Father and son stood in front of the broken stone. The pine forest behind it was black and heavy. There was no wind and no birdsong. It was so quiet it was as if someone had put the sound of the whole mountain into a sack and carried it off.

label.en: Look at the back of the stele

exits.means: looks at the back of the stele, as Granny Wu said; compares the token

story.zh:
小满想起吴婆婆的话，绕到碑后，扒开半人高的枯草，只见碑的背面没有字，只在最底下刻着一只小小的狐狸，蜷着身子，尾巴绕着身子。他把怀里的木牌掏出来比了一比，竟是一模一样。

小满心里咯噔一下，看看木牌，又看看碑，又看看木牌，然后拿定了一个主意：把木牌收好，什么都不说。有些事说了出来，他爹今天便不会进去了；他爹不进去，马三便要来收弓；马三来收弓，他娘便又要蹲在地上捡东西。

这笔账，他算得清清楚楚。
story.en:
Xiaoman remembered what Granny Wu had said. He went round behind the stone and parted the dead grass, which stood half as high as a man. The back of the stone had no writing on it. Only at the very bottom was a small fox carved, curled up, its tails wrapped round its body. He took the wooden tablet out of his jacket and held it up beside the carving. They were exactly the same.

Xiaoman's heart gave a jolt. He looked at the tablet, then at the stone, then at the tablet again, and made up his mind: put the tablet away and say nothing. Some things, said out loud, would mean his father wouldn't go in today; if his father didn't go in, Ma San would come for the bow; if Ma San came for the bow, his mother would be crouching on the floor picking things up again.

That sum he'd worked out to the last copper.

label.en: Make three rules, and go in with him

exits.means: goes in with father on conditions, sets rules, marks, turns back by sundown, runs if anything is wrong

story.zh:
他爹在碑前站了好一会儿，伸手摸了摸那两个字。他低头看了看碑脚那溜蹄印，又看了看天，道：「你在这儿等我。」小满没有说「我不」，想了一想，道：「爹。你的腿，追不上鹿。」

小满竖起三根手指，道：「我跟你进去。但咱们定三条规矩。一，每走一百步，我在树上刻一道记号。二，太阳一过那道山梁，不管追没追到，掉头就走。三——」他看着他爹的眼睛，「只要有一样东西不对劲，不管是什么，不商量。跑。」

他爹看着他，半晌，道：「好。听你的。」两人跨过了断碑。

小满在身边那棵树上刻下了第一道记号，手有点抖，刻歪了；便又在旁边刻了一道，这一回没歪。他当即决定，第一道不算。
story.en:
His father stood in front of the stone for a good while. He reached out and touched those two words. He looked down at the line of hoof prints at the foot of the stone, looked up at the sky, and said, "You wait here for me." Xiaoman didn't say "I won't." He thought about it and said, "Pa. With your leg, you can't catch a deer."

Xiaoman held up three fingers. "I'm coming in with you. But we set three rules. One: every hundred steps, I cut a mark on a tree. Two: once the sun's past that ridge, caught it or not, we turn round and go. Three—" he looked his father in the eye, "if anything at all seems wrong, whatever it is, we don't discuss it. We run."

His father looked at him for a long moment. "All right. We'll do it your way." The two of them stepped over the broken stone.

Xiaoman cut the first mark on the tree beside him. His hand shook a little and it came out crooked, so he cut another one next to it. This time it wasn't crooked. He decided on the spot that the first one didn't count.

story_full.zh:
他爹在碑前站了好一会儿，伸手摸了摸那两个字，指头在「勿」字上停了一停。他爹的爹，就是从这儿进去的。他低头看了看碑脚那溜蹄印，又看了看天，道：「你在这儿等我。」

小满没有说「我不」，想了一想，道：「爹。你的腿，追不上鹿。」他爹登时愣住了。

小满竖起三根手指，道：「我跟你进去。但咱们定三条规矩。一，每走一百步，我在树上刻一道记号。二，太阳一过那道山梁，不管追没追到，掉头就走。三——」他看着他爹的眼睛，「只要有一样东西不对劲，不管是什么，不商量。跑。」

他爹看着他，半晌，道：「好。听你的。」又道：「……你娘教的？」小满道：「嗯，是娘教的。」他爹长长地叹了一口气，那口气里一半是放心，还有一半，是有点吃醋。

他道：「随她。随她好。」

小满把那只山鸡拴在他爹背后的箭壶带子上。

两人跨过了断碑。

小满在身边那棵树上刻下了第一道记号，手有点抖，刻歪了；便又在旁边刻了一道，这一回没歪。他当即决定，第一道不算。
story_full.en:
His father stood in front of the stone for a good while. He reached out and touched those two words, and his finger rested a moment on "NOT". His father's father had gone in from right here. He looked down at the line of hoof prints at the foot of the stone, looked up at the sky, and said, "You wait here for me."

Xiaoman didn't say "I won't." He thought about it and said, "Pa. With your leg, you can't catch a deer." His father was stopped dead.

Xiaoman held up three fingers. "I'm coming in with you. But we set three rules. One: every hundred steps, I cut a mark on a tree. Two: once the sun's past that ridge, caught it or not, we turn round and go. Three—" he looked his father in the eye, "if anything at all seems wrong, whatever it is, we don't discuss it. We run."

His father looked at him for a long moment. "All right. We'll do it your way." Then: "…Your mother taught you that?" Xiaoman said, "Mm. Ma taught me." His father let out a long, long sigh. Half of it was relief, and the other half was a little bit of jealousy.

He said, "You take after her. Good that you take after her."

Xiaoman tied the pheasant to the quiver strap on his father's back.

The two of them stepped over the broken stone.

Xiaoman cut the first mark on the tree beside him. His hand shook a little and it came out crooked, so he cut another one next to it. This time it wasn't crooked. He decided on the spot that the first one didn't count.

exits.means: wants to go back to the village, gives up the hunt

story.zh:
小满道：「爹，咱回吧。」他爹没回头，道：「回去，弓就没了。」顿了一顿，又道：「没了弓，冬天拿什么打肉？拿我的膝盖？」

小满看了看他缠着麻布的膝盖。那膝盖早上还话多，这会儿一句话都没说。他也没再说话。
story.en:
Xiaoman said, "Dad, let's go home." His father didn't turn round. "Go home, and the bow's gone." A pause. "No bow, and what do we hunt meat with this winter? My knee?"

Xiaoman looked at the hemp-bound knee. That morning it had had plenty to say; now it said nothing at all. He didn't say any more either.

label.en: Leave Father here and go in alone

exits.means: wants to go in alone, leaving father behind

story.zh:
小满道：「你在这儿等我。我一个人进去。」他爹一把攥住了他的胳膊，攥得他生疼，道：「你爷爷，就是一个人进去的。」

他没再往下说。小满也没再提。
story.en:
Xiaoman said, "You wait here. I'll go in alone." His father seized his arm, gripping so hard it hurt. "Your grandpa went in alone."

He said no more. Xiaoman didn't raise it again.
